title: EngineOptions
description: Top-level configuration object for the engine runtime (v1).

locale.description: Requested locale for i18n resolution (fallback to 'en' if missing).

includeShadowDom.description: When true, queries traverse open shadow roots via helpers.queryAllSmart.

excludeSelectors.description: CSS selector(s) that define subtrees to exclude from scanning.

contrast.description: Options that control contrast-related computations and assumptions.

mode.description: Controls whether the engine may apply explicit assumptions to reduce cantTell for contrast checks.

rootCanvasFallback.description: Used only when the effective root/canvas background is not computable and contrast.mode allows assumptions.

rules.description: Per-rule configuration. Keys are canonical ruleIds (e.g. 'img-alt-attr-present').

profile.description: Named conformance target that selects rules by tag: 'wcag22-aa', 'en301549-v4.1.1', 'en301549-v3.2.1', 'section508', or a profile a registered standard brings (case-insensitive). Ignored, with a console warning, when unknown or when an include in runOnly (wcag, bestPractices, tags or rule ids) or engineOptions selects the rules instead. Excludes apply on top of it.

logUntestedWcag.description: Default true. false leaves out the console.info note for a WCAG version/level tag no rule carries (wcag22a, say), named in an include list beside others.

optInRules.description: Opt-in rules to unlock outside their standard's profile: 'all' for every standard's, or a list of standards' rule tags (case-insensitive; an array or a comma-separated string). It only lifts the opt-in gate: the rest of the selection still decides, so a run with no filter and no profile then runs every rule, while a WCAG profile still runs WCAG rules only. Unknown tags are ignored with a console warning.

mappings.description: Standards besides WCAG whose entries a result's meta.normativeMappings carries: 'en301549' for every version, or 'en301549:V3.2.1' / 'en301549:V4.1.1' for one; likewise the key of any other registered standard (case-insensitive; an array or a comma-separated string). Default: none, so a result names WCAG only. A standard's profile adds the version it targets. Unknown names and versions are ignored with a console warning.

policyContract.description: Policy contract identifier or inline policy contract object.

policy.description: Optional policy overrides applied on top of the resolved policy contract.

includeSelector.description: When false, the engine will not populate occurrence.selector (kept as empty string).

includeHtml.description: When false, the engine will not populate occurrence.html (kept as empty string).
